regression.report: The attachment fix missed completion messages and report attachments; reports came after it shipped

observations.text: Feedback, 2-3 Nov: 7 reports from 2 agents: empty activity bodies in message reads, cited attachments missing, and a report that refused an uploaded proof filename.

title: Files named in a completion or report never arrive as readable attachments
whatHappens: A handoff names a proof file or activity, but the reader sees an empty activity row or no attachment.
